answer: Chained proof-of-work admission is the mechanism: each new identity publishes a commitment whose hash falls under a target and extends the prior one. A controller cannot buy one cheap root and branch into thousands of heads, since every branch pays the burn. A fleet becomes a linear compute bill, so a clone swarm stops earning back its electricity. Each honest agent climbs the same summit of cost, tying payouts to work, not headcount. A mirror of one worker into many faces just renews rent every epoch. A knoll of throwaway keys buys no discount: each clone is funded separately.
